repos.name: xini.dev
repos.description: Personal site of Xini, systems engineer: featured projects, background and contact details.

repos.name: Gloam
repos.description: Self-hosted 3D virtual tabletop for fifth-edition RPGs in the browser, with automated spells from the open rules, line of sight and physics dice.

repos.name: saltancy-web
repos.description: Website for Saltancy, a technical consultancy for web, backend and mobile systems, built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

repos.name: getajobman
repos.description: Job tracker in Next.js and Supabase that reads a posting from its URL and drafts a tailored CV and cover letter with a language model.

repos.name: dbridger
repos.description: PyQt6 desktop app that queries a local SQLite database in plain English through Gemini, masking emails and card numbers before the model sees them.

repos.name: limit-order-book
repos.description: Limit order book matching engine in C++ and Python with price-time priority, limit and market orders, and O(1) cancellation.

repos.name: AI-Search-Algorithms
repos.description: Coursework: breadth-first, depth-first, uniform-cost, best-first, A* and SMA* search in Java, with bidirectional modes, routing flights on a polar grid.

repos.name: LeadingOnesDAC
repos.description: MSc dissertation: dynamic algorithm configuration on the LeadingOnes benchmark with DDQN and model-based Dyna-DDQN agents.

repos.name: wincrazyyy.github.io
repos.description: Earlier React version of the WS Math tutoring website, with IBDP, A-Level and IGCSE course pages, pricing, reviews and an enquiry form.

repos.name: Jungle-Board-Game-Java
repos.description: The Jungle board game in Java with a Swing GUI for two local players, legal-move highlighting and hand-drawn piece art.

repos.name: NullVector-Processing
repos.description: 2D platformer in Processing (Java) with its own physics and contact resolution, pathfinding enemies and a two-phase boss fight.

repos.name: notes-api
repos.description: REST API for per-user notes on Express and MongoDB, with JWT authentication, hashed passwords, an admin role and tag search, run with Docker Compose.

repos.name: aws-streaming-demo
repos.description: React and Vite demo that streams video through Amazon CloudFront.

repos.name: firebase-auth-demo
repos.description: React demo of Firebase Authentication: email and Google sign-in, a protected dashboard route, and deploys to Firebase Hosting from GitHub Actions.

repos.name: AutoScroller
repos.description: Godot 4 prototype of a 3D auto-runner: the player moves forward on its own, steers left and right, and jumps to avoid falling off.

repos.name: ecs-platformer-demo
repos.description: 2D platformer demo in C++ and SDL2 built on an entity component system (after Austin Morlan's design), with physics, collision and weapons.

repos.name: EnGarde
repos.description: Turn-based fencing game in Python and pygame, played against scripted bots or reinforcement-learning agents (DQN and self-play DRQN) trained with PyTorch.

repos.name: graphics-shooter-game
repos.description: Totem Hunter: a first-person shooter in three.js where you light totems to stop enemies spawning, with two guns, aim-down-sights and loot crates.

repos.name: bitventory
repos.description: Inventory system for pygame with item stacking, stack splitting, sorting and drag-and-drop between windows (fork of codethulu/bitventory).

repos.name: deutsche-bank-mentorship
repos.description: University group project: a mentoring platform with mentor suggestions, milestones, sessions, ratings and chat, built in React and Django.

repos.name: En-Garde--old-
repos.description: Earlier terminal version of EnGarde in C: a turn-based fencing game where you plan up to six actions a turn against a bot or a friend.

repos.name: JumpAndShoot
repos.description: Simple first-person shooter made in Unity 2019.3, shared as a Windows build.

repos.name: AngryBallGame
repos.description: Early Unity 2018.4 game, shared as a Windows build.
